audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed on every row. The full layer gave Pantheon levels 1-3, 4-5 and 2+ items with 'Skill' at 6 and first item; the content layer gave LeBlanc all seven. A reader saw two different answers to 'who wins level 1'.
audit.why: At 53.04% over 1544 games the honest split is Pantheon early and LeBlanc from levels 4-5 on: he has a point-and-click 600-range dash-stun on 13s and frontal invulnerability on Aegis Assault, but no way to catch a Distortion round trip once she has the mana and the levels.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Pantheon in both layers; rows 3-6 to LeBlanc in both layers. Whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ultimate was called 'Grand Skyfall' in spikes[1] and wants.you[2].
audit.why: It is Grand Starfall — 180/165/150s, 5500 range. The wrong name and a missing cooldown made the level-6 spike read as vague dive anxiety instead of a 3-minute timer you can track.
audit.corrected: Name and numbers written in at both spikes and in the cooldowns field.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault was never mentioned, and the page twice claimed Pantheon has 'no ranged tools' / 'zero ranged tools'.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front for 22/21/20/19/18s of cooldown — it eats a timed burst dumped into his face, and being a channel, Ethereal Chains or a mimicked chain cancels it outright. That is the decisive interaction in this lane. Comet Spear is also a genuine ranged tool at 575, just shorter than Sigil's 700 — which is the actual spacing rule.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault's front-only invulnerability, the channel cancel, and the 575-vs-700 range gap all stated.

audit.why: Shield Vault at 13s down to 9s is the clock that decides when LeBlanc may stand still at all.

edits.before: Pantheon is a lane bully whose entire kit depends on landing Shield Vault's stun to enable a full combo, and he has no ranged tool to punish you if you simply play at max distance and poke with Sigil. Bait his stun with the clone whenever he looks to engage, since he has no follow-up mobility once it's spent, and punish the real body freely once he's cooldown-locked. As long as you respect his all-in windows and don't melee-trade him blind, you win this lane comfortably from level 2 onward.
edits.after: Pantheon is a lane bully whose kit depends on landing Shield Vault's stun to open a full combo. His only ranged tool is Comet Spear at 575, so Sigil poke from 700 is the safe exchange. Bait the dash with the clone whenever he steps up, since he has no follow-up mobility once it is spent, then burst the real body while it sits on 13 seconds. Aegis Assault is a channel — Ethereal Chains cancels it outright — and its invulnerability only covers his front, so damage from behind still lands.

edits.before: At 6 your full combo still kills him before he can flash in with Grand Skyfall for a follow-up dive, provided you keep vision up and don't get caught out alone in unwarded areas. His ultimate is a global engage tool that can be scary for surprise picks, but in a straight lane 1v1 it does nothing he couldn't already do by walking up, so the core interaction remains the same: bait Shield Vault, then burst him down. Keep roaming with confidence, since his lack of ranged pressure means he can't punish your rotations from lane.
edits.after: At 6 your full combo still kills him before Grand Starfall can land a follow-up dive, provided you keep vision up and don't get caught alone in unwarded areas. The ultimate is a 5500-range global on 180 seconds — frightening for surprise picks, but in a lane 1v1 it does nothing walking up would not, so the core interaction stands: bait Shield Vault, cancel Aegis Assault with the chain, then burst him. Keep roaming, since 575 range on Comet Spear cannot punish your rotations.

edits.before: Pantheon's Grand Skyfall remains a real threat for surprise dives onto your backline or split-pushers, so ward key entry points and don't wander alone without vision. In a straight skirmish, though, he still has no answer to your ranged burst and mobility, and his damage falls off relative to yours as the game goes long. Play around the dive threat positionally, and this matchup stays comfortably in your favor into the late game.
edits.after: Pantheon's Grand Starfall remains a real threat for surprise dives onto your backline or split-pushers, so ward the entry points and don't wander alone without vision. In a straight skirmish he answers burst with Aegis Assault, which covers his front for the whole channel, so open from behind or hold the chain to cancel it. Play around the dive threat positionally and this matchup stays in your favor late.
